adjudicated.jp: 言いたいことは山ほどあった。
adjudicated.en: The size of the amount of things I wanted to tell were a mountain,
adjudicated.assessment: The Japanese idiom says he had a mountain of things to say. The English is grammatically malformed and literalizes the quantity twice.
adjudicated.remedy: There was a mountain of things I wanted to say,
